description: Copilot harness compatibility map for the feat/copilot-harness-only branch. Agent frontmatter stays canonical; this file declares how model labels, tool IDs and frontmatter fields translate to the GitHub Copilot SDK runtime and Copilot custom-agent profiles. Validated by tools/scripts/validate-harness-compat.mjs.

sdk.evidence: Live SDK spike probes 1 and 2 (2026-10-01): model/effort, tool restriction, worker allowlist via onPreToolUse, ask_user, permissions and cold resume on 02-Requirements with challenger-review-subagent.

router_owned.reasoning-effort: Router passes it as SDK reasoningEffort; Copilot profiles cannot express it.
router_owned.agents: Router denies non-listed task targets in onPreToolUse; infer:false alone does not prevent self-nesting.
router_owned.handoffs: Ignored by Copilot clients; replaced by apex-recall checkpoints and router routing.
router_owned.argument-hint: Ignored by Copilot clients; router CLI help carries invocation hints.

read/problems.note: VS Code diagnostics are editor-only; use the language's CLI linter or build instead.

read/terminalLastCommand.note: Editor terminal state is not visible to Copilot sessions.

read/terminalSelection.note: Editor terminal selection is not visible to Copilot sessions.

search/codebase.note: No semantic codebase search; text and glob search substitute.

ask_user.note: Copilot runtime question tool (spike check 1 passed in all three clients). Cloud agent cannot ask mid-task; checkpoint and stop instead.

vscode/askQuestions.note: VS Code Local harness only. Copilot runtimes ignore this name and do not map it to ask_user (microsoft/vscode#314010); list ask_user as well.

apex-azure-mcp/*.note: Copilot sessions reach only local MCP servers that need no interactive authentication.

bicep/*.note: Copilot sessions reach only local MCP servers that need no interactive authentication.

apex/status.note: apex workflow MCP server (plugin server `apex`; contributors run it from source). Qualified per client in BL-14.
